newsitem.title: MEXICO: Breakdown of Mexico GDP increase for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Breakdown of Mexico GDP increase for 1996.

text.p: The Mexican Finance Ministry released a breakdown of real gross domestic product (GDP) figures for 1996.
It said real GDP rose 5.1 percent in 1996 compared to the year earlier.
Farming, forestry and fishing rose a mere 1.2 percent in the full year, it said.

The industrial sector surged 10.4 percent. Of that, mining rose 8.3 percent, manufacturing rose 10.9 percent, construction was up 11.4 percent, and power generation, electricity, gas and water rose 4.5 percent.

The service sector rose 3.1 percent in the year. Of that commerce, restaurants, and hotels rose 4.1 percent; transport and communications rose 8.7 percent; financial services, insurances and real estate rose 1.4 percent; and personal services rose 1.0 percent, it said.
